sources: EA Madden NFL 27 launch roster (madden27_ea_players.csv, 2362 players)
EA Gameplay Deep Dive: Madden abilities are Bronze/Silver/Gold and stack; Bronze is elite, not a starter tier
EA Franchise Deep Dive: Franchise tiers upgrade from relevant ratings as the player progresses
CFB 26 Dynasty Deep Dive analog: physical ability tiers require attribute floors (e.g. Platinum Shifty 97 COD + 96 ACC). Madden 27 uses three tiers instead of five
Madden Tools / Madden School Madden 26 franchise gates (archetype + OVR 70/80/85/90) — legacy, not M27. Madden Tools still labels its pages as Madden 26 as of 2026-08-28
MUT.GG MUT 26 discounted-bucket example (Short Route KO 94 MCV, Medium Route KO 96 MCV) — Ultimate Team only, not Franchise
abilities.clutchtrait.com Madden 27 datamine: confirms Bronze/Silver/Gold effect stacking; does not publish rating floors

tierModel.bronze: Elite entry. Default 88 primary, or launch-roster observed min (clamped 82-90) when n>=3.

abilities.name: Ironman
abilities.description: Players with this ability avoid any ratings penalties associated with playing outside of their primary position

abilities.name: Run Protector
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using most quick run block shed moves.

abilities.name: Pass Protector
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using most quick pass block shed moves.

abilities.name: Steamroller
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.

abilities.name: Phenom
abilities.description: Some athletes defy classification as much as they defy boundaries. When they enter the zone, they are highly likely to win the first interaction they have with a defender.

abilities.name: Edge Protector
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.

abilities.name: Dual Threat
abilities.description: The most devastating defensive players often excel via versatility. When they enter the zone, they have an increased chance of defeating pass blocks, and knocking catches loose.

abilities.name: Bottleneck
abilities.description: Bottleneck defenders realize that the best way to stop a route is to act early. When they enter the zone, they are highly likely to dominantly win any man press encounter.

abilities.name: Ankle Breaker
abilities.description: Truly devastating receiving threats are the ones that catch and can't be caught. When they enter the zone, they have increased fakeout rates on spin/juke/hurdle after the catch.

abilities.name: YAC 'Em Up
abilities.description: The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.

abilities.name: Universal Coverage
abilities.description: The most physical coverage defenders prevent catches from happening even when their target has hands on the ball. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed knockouts.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.description: The most tenacious defenders beat their blocks by sheer force of will. When they enter the zone, their rush move attempts are free.

abilities.name: Truzz
abilities.description: The most effective ball carriers prioritize maintaining possession over all else. When they enter the zone, no tackles made against them will result in a fumble.

abilities.name: Momentum Shift
abilities.description: Momentum Shift players demoralize their opponents. When they enter the zone, all on field opponents are knocked out of the zone or lose any progress towards entering the zone.

abilities.name: Brick Wall
abilities.description: While in the pocket, passers with this ability are almost guaranteed to break the first sack attempt by any blitzing defender

abilities.name: Freight Train
abilities.description: Freight Trains are relentless runners who refuse to go down on first contact. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance to break the next tackle.

abilities.name: Reinforcement
abilities.description: The game's top defenders excel in all situations. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance of defeating run blocks, and disrupting catches via tackles.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.

abilities.name: First One Free
abilities.description: Some players thrive on making defenders look silly. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their fakeout rate on the next juke, spin or hurdle.

abilities.name: Run & Gun
abilities.description: Many passers use a combination of mobility and aggressiveness to make big plays. When they enter the zone, they have elite accuracy while throwing on the run.

abilities.name: Shutdown
abilities.description: Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.

abilities.name: Double Me
abilities.description: Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.

abilities.name: Bazooka
abilities.description: Quarterbacks with generational arms have the power to stretch any defense to its breaking point. When they enter the zone, their maximum throw distance is increased

abilities.name: Pro Reads
abilities.description: For great quarterbacks, vision and anticipation are paramount. When they enter the zone, their first open receiver is highlighted and they ignore defensive pressure.

abilities.name: Dots
abilities.description: Accurate passers know that ball placement is the difference between a touchdown and a turnover. When they enter the zone, all passes are thrown with elite accuracy and result in more completions

abilities.name: Fearmonger
abilities.description: Some pass rushers intimidate quarterbacks with their sheer presence. When they enter the zone, they can apply significant pressure on quarterbacks even while engaged with blockers.

abilities.name: Deep Elite
abilities.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 20+ yards from the LoS

abilities.name: Interior Threat
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the interior of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

abilities.name: Linchpin
abilities.description: Players with this ability grant improved blocking to the entire offensive line.

abilities.name: Zen Kicker
abilities.description: Kickers with this ability experience a slower kicking meter for better power and accuracy on kicks over 45 yards.

abilities.name: 3rd Down Threat
abilities.description: On 3rd down, receivers with this ability have a better chance to win contested catches against single coverage up to 25 yards from the line of scrimmage.

abilities.name: High Point Deadeye
abilities.description: Passers with this ability have elite accuracy on unpressured high point throws under 20 yards.

abilities.name: Inside Shade
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and inside the numbers

abilities.name: Outside Shade
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers

abilities.name: Demoralizer
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a hit-stick tackle.

abilities.name: On The Ball
abilities.description: Players with this ability are much less likely to be fooled by WR runoffs

abilities.name: Runoff Elite
abilities.description: Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs

abilities.name: Recuperation
abilities.description: Players with this ability will recover from the effects of Wear and Tear and fatigue at a slightly increased rate between plays.

abilities.name: Backlash
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties against their tackler when tackled via a non-conservative tackle.

abilities.name: Deflator
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.

abilities.name: Fearless
abilities.description: Passers with this ability have a reduced chance to be impacted by throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while on the run

abilities.name: Reach For It
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will have a slightly reduced fumble chance while reaching for extra yards during tackles

abilities.name: One Step Ahead
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage

abilities.name: Outmatched
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to force catch knockouts against running backs

abilities.name: Adrenaline Rush
abilities.description: Pass rushers with this ability will heal some of their fatigue after sacking the QB

abilities.name: Energizer
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability will replenish a small portion of their stamina upon successfully performing any skill move

abilities.name: El Toro
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to receive dominant bull rush wins when their stamina is full. This consumes a large amount of additional stamina.

abilities.name: Max Effort
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting pass rush moves with effort

abilities.name: Medium Route KO
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus medium routes 10-20 yards from the LoS

abilities.name: Swim Club
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting swim/club pass rush moves

abilities.name: Mr. Big Stop
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will start 3rd or 4th down with slightly increased fatigue replenishment

abilities.name: B.O.G.O.
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending stamina to perform one

abilities.name: Unpredictable
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability are less likely to increase their blocker's resistance bars when performing shed wins

abilities.name: Instant Rebate
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability are refunded stamina when they successfully shed blocks

abilities.name: Lumberjack
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased success rate and cause more fumbles when cut-sticking ballcarriers.

abilities.name: Out My Way
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability will have a slightly increased chance to win impact blocks against receivers.

abilities.name: Tank
abilities.description: Ballcarriers with this ability have an increased chance to break hit-stick tackle attempts made on them.

abilities.name: No Outsiders
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping outside zone plays.

abilities.name: Inside Stuff
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping inside run plays.

abilities.name: Goal Line Stuff
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have slightly improved run shed moves and disengage angles for a better chance at stopping runs within 5 yards of the goal line.

abilities.name: Puller Elite
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt slightly improved pull blocks vs. DBs

abilities.name: Nasty Streak
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.

abilities.name: All Day
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability will allow less frequent shed attempts by their block target

abilities.name: Threat Detector
abilities.description: Players with this ability will highlight any user defenders.

abilities.name: Extra Credit
abilities.description: Pass rushers with this ability pay a slightly reduced stamina cost for each move they attempt

abilities.name: Screen Protector
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks on screen plays

abilities.name: Evasive

abilities.name: Gift-Wrapped
abilities.description: Passers with this ability have a better chance to complete passes to uncovered halfbacks.

abilities.name: Lurker
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability can make spectacular interceptions while lurking in zones, and are more likely to attempt and succeed at diving swats/catches.

abilities.name: Secure Protector
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.

abilities.name: Deep Route KO

abilities.name: Acrobat

abilities.name: Juke Box

abilities.name: Inside Deadeye

abilities.name: Human Joystick

abilities.name: Matchup Nightmare

abilities.name: Backfield Mismatch
abilities.description: Running backs with this ability have slightly improved catch in traffic and route running when coming out of the backfield against linebackers and linemen.

abilities.name: Secure Tackler
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have an increased chance to avoid fakeouts.

abilities.name: Enforcer
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability allow fewer broken tackles when hit-sticking ballcarriers - regardless of the runner's size or power.

abilities.name: Under Pressure

abilities.name: Post Up
abilities.description: Blockers with this ability have a slightly increased chance to win any double team block they are engaged in.

abilities.name: Deep In Zone KO

abilities.name: Red Zone Threat

abilities.name: Deep Out Zone KO

abilities.name: Mid Zone KO

abilities.name: Flat Zone KO

abilities.name: Edge Threat
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

abilities.name: Deep Out Elite

abilities.name: Short Out Elite
abilities.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

abilities.name: Slot-O-Matic

abilities.name: Gunslinger

abilities.name: Extender

abilities.name: Fastbreak
abilities.description: Passers with this ability receive better blocking support on designed quarterback run plays.

abilities.name: Short Route KO
abilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from the LoS

abilities.name: Sideline Deadeye

abilities.name: Lofting Deadeye

abilities.name: Long Range Deadeye

abilities.name: Route Technician

abilities.name: Roaming Deadeye

abilities.name: Red Zone Deadeye

abilities.name: Pocket Deadeye

abilities.name: Tough Nut

abilities.name: Dashing Deadeye

abilities.name: Bruiser

abilities.name: Arm Bar

abilities.name: Quick Jump
